items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And I read Paul, God is no respecter of person.

ctx.x: But isn’t that funny? But that is funny, poignant, grim, but funny. It’s just funny you know. Because if I had accepted race, I would never have sung that song. But I have never accepted that. I don’t accept anything but God’s children. And I read Paul, God is no respecter of person. So who is man to cause problems, and to have all this racial — all these politicians talking about the problems between black and white, already are expressing gross ungodliness. And lack of belief in any real God you know. And this…
We can all learn from some of those comments. That’s wonderful.
